reviews.text: Irene was super kind and patient with my kittens! She helped explain everything to me and it was a really calm and pleasant experience.

Helped me with everything I needed to take my cat on a trip.
The service was great from the get go,
David helped me with all my questions with great patience
Excellent service, they helped us with everything we needed to travel to Argentina with my cat.
Fabulous, a top-notch veterinary team.
Excellent professionals. They take care of both their patients and their patients' owners.
It's wonderful to find a vet and staff who take such kind care of your kitten, Irene is a real gem in every way.

Spacious and bright, with no noise, which is much appreciated by the animals. A fantastic team, from administration to veterinarians, especially Dr. Irene Moñiz, in whom my furry family and I have complete confidence. ❤️
David and Sonia provided excellent service; they were very professional, made our dog feel very comfortable, and gave us all the necessary help to take him on a trip outside the EU.
Everything was perfect, very professional, I had a very good experience.
Highly recommended, clean, attentive, and professional. They helped us with an international veterinary certificate.

David was incredible and had my pup fully ready to cross the French/UK border, with an appointment last minute and all the EU passport and worm paperwork in order. I passed doggie immigration with flying colours (amazingly). Smooth. Will recommend to everyone.
They're the best—attentive, fast, and loving with our furry friends. Thank you so much!
The service is magnificent. Irene, my cats' vet, is not only a good professional but you can also tell she loves them.

Thank you for this review, Antonio. We are thrilled to receive your recognition. We will continue to strive to care for your four-legged companions with the same dedication and affection. We hope to see you again when you need us!

Thank you so much for your 5-star review, Fatma. We're delighted to hear that your experience at Tres Torres Veterinaris - Clínica del Benestar was positive. The entire team works every day to provide attentive, professional care focused on the well-being of each patient. Thank you for trusting us!

A very good experience. The whole team is very professional and clearly has a wealth of knowledge. I always felt well taken care of and confident that my cats were in good hands. The reception staff is also excellent: they are friendly, organized, and always willing to help. They also have a consultation room exclusively for cats, which makes the visit much less stressful.

An excellent experience with David. From the very first moment, he was very professional, attentive, and clear, guiding us through the entire process of transporting our dog. He was always available to answer our questions and ensured that everything was done correctly, giving us great peace of mind. I would definitely recommend his services to anyone who needs to organize the international transport of their pet.
Very kind and attentive.
Great experience and service to great the pet passport and other treatments. Dr. David was very thorough and helpful and he also speaks English. Highly recommend!

We got our EU veterinary health certificate for our cats for our travels from Barcelona to USA. Dr David and front desk staff were great! They were very warm and helpful. Dr. was very gentle with our cats. They gave us a goodie bag for our cats for their travel which was very thoughtful!
Excellent service, excellent professionals!
Very professional and fast.

I had a fantastic experience at this veterinary clinic. They were incredibly kind and professional throughout, and treated my cat with so much love and care. I'm so grateful for all their help. I highly recommend them!
They helped me with all the paperwork so my dog ​​could travel from Spain to Peru. They gave me all the necessary information so I could make the trip without any problems. Highly recommended!

The team at Tres Torres was able to see us quickly, and I couldn’t be more pleased with the services provided. My dog was treated with the utmost care, and all of my concerns were addressed. We will absolutely be back for check ups and routines. Thank you!
The way they treat dogs and the personal attention they give is incredible. Highly recommended. David, Irene, and Sonia have all been delightful every time they've helped me.
Very kind and empathetic in every aspect, from the beginning of the veterinary certificate process to its completion. Very attentive throughout. I thank you all very much.

Today I went to complete the paperwork to bring my cat to Argentina. They treated me wonderfully. David advised me on everything and was very attentive, as was the lady at reception. It was a highly recommended experience; they make you feel comfortable. I highly recommend them. David took care of every detail, and they were incredibly friendly and kind.
Everything was excellent, very kind.

Thank you very much for your 5-star rating, Darío. At Tres Torres Veterinaris - Clínica del Benestar we are very happy to know that you had a positive experience with our team. We will continue to work with proximity, care and commitment to offer the best possible care to animals and their families.
Very good experience
Very attentive :)
Excellent service!!! Highly recommended

I'm so glad I brought Merlin, my dog, to see Jaume Fatjo for help with Merlin's anxiety. I came into your clinic desperate, not knowing how else to help Merlin, and I'm leaving with immense hope and joy, knowing we're in the best hands and on the right track. The whole team, especially Irene when she drew Merlin's blood and Sonia, the receptionist who brings joy to both humans and our four-legged friends... Thank you so much, you're all wonderful!
I found the service provided by the professional who assisted me today to be excellent, and the service at the counter from the assistant was very friendly.
Very friendly and very efficient.

I contacted the clinic to prepare the international travel documents for my two dogs, and from the very first moment, the service was excellent. They contacted me by phone and explained everything step by step, very clearly.
At the clinic, the treatment they received was very caring and professional. Everything went exactly as they had instructed, with great attention to detail.
I especially want to thank the veterinarian, David, for his kindness, and the entire team for their professionalism and helpfulness. Everything went perfectly!
Excellent service! They were very attentive and advised me on everything I needed to know to travel with my pet. David and Sonia helped me.

Even before I got my puppy, I went to them with questions, and I knew right away it was the right place. I'm very happy with them, and so is my puppy; he's not afraid to go. I highly recommend them; you won't regret it. They're very professional and, above all, they have empathy and love for both the animals and their owners!
Thank you very much for your review, Pedro. It is very important for the entire team to know that your experience at the clinic has been satisfactory.
Everything was perfect, very professional. We had our pet checked and processed a Cexgan application for travel outside of Europe. Everything was handled correctly. 100% recommended.

Great overall experience. Very friendly and welcoming staff (Sonia at the front desk and David the veterinarian), prompt in responding to messages and arranging appointments, and super professional and attentive service. Highly recommend them to anyone who is new to the city like I am.
Excellent service from the entire team. They were a great help with the paperwork and arrangements for traveling with my cat. They were incredibly clear and attentive throughout the process.
Thanks to David, who helped me bring my Maltipoo to Dubai. Everything was excellent.

Muchísimas gracias al equipo de la clínica veterinaria Tres Torres, y en especial a Sonia y David, por su atención, cuidado y ayuda.
Nos recibieron con mucha calidez, nos explicaron todo con detalle y nos ayudaron a resolver todas las gestiones necesarias.
Son personas muy atentas, profesionales y realmente humanas.
Fue un verdadero placer tratar con ellos.
Mi gata, que se llama Barcelona, ​​también quedó muy contenta 😊
¡Recomiendo la clínica de todo corazón!

A huge thank you to the Tres Torres Veterinary Clinic team, as well as Sonia and David, for their attention, care, and assistance.
We were warmly welcomed, everything was explained in detail, and they helped us with all our questions.
They are incredibly attentive, professional, and truly caring people.
I thoroughly enjoyed interacting with them.
My cat, Barcelona, ​​was also very pleased 😊
I highly recommend the clinic!
Very good experience with them regarding traveling with cats internationally and they accompanied me through the entire process. Thank you very much!!

I had a terrible experience with this veterinarian. I took my dog ​​in for atopic dermatitis, and they barely even examined her. They told me there was nothing they could do, and since she's an adopted dog, they implied I should consider returning her because skin problems are among the most expensive to treat. I found that comment completely inappropriate, insensitive, and irresponsible coming from someone who should love animals. Awful.

They always treat me with such warmth and kindness that I truly appreciate it. It's clear they are genuine professionals who care about the animals' well-being. Every time I've been there, I've felt well-advised and completely confident. I wholeheartedly recommend them.
The care at this vet is wonderful! They always look after Tuti with so much love and patience, and they make us feel right at home. Thank you for everything you do for Tuti 💛. …
I went to Costa Rica and David helped me with all the formalities; everything was perfect. Thank you.
